svg.title: moves the zero transverse diagonal readout to all transverse diagonal entries on single momentum axes. Longitudinal entries vanish by transversality. Reflection parity then kills mixed momentum entries in a diagonal link component and same momentum entries in an off-diagonal link component. The only remaining possibility has its two distinct momentum axes equal to its two link axes. Transversality at the sum of those two coordinate vectors makes twice that entry zero, since the diagonal entries have already vanished. Bilinearity gives Q = 0. The degree-three term vanishes under total inversion, whose momentum sign is odd and whose two link signs multiply to one. The difference thus starts at degree four. This proves the one-axis kinetic identification used below, including the Taylor normalization and reflected-edge convention.
